baseball_diamond: a satellite image of baseball_diamond with a compact diamond-shaped infield and surrounding open play area, different from stadium by weaker spectator enclosure and from ground_track_field by lacking an oval running track.
beach: a satellite image of beach with bright coastal sand and a distinct shoreline, different from desert by direct land-water contact and from harbor by lacking organized docks.
bridge: a satellite image of bridge with a narrow man-made crossing over water or land, different from overpass by weaker road-over-road elevation and from freeway by lacking a long traffic corridor.
dense_residential: a satellite image of dense_residential with highly compact roof distribution and very small spacing between buildings, different from sparse_residential by much denser neighborhood organization.
desert: a satellite image of desert with dry homogeneous barren texture and very limited vegetation, different from beach by lacking water-connected shoreline.
forest: a satellite image of forest with continuous dense canopy and dark green natural texture, different from meadow by stronger canopy continuity and from wetland by weaker visible water fragmentation.
harbor: a satellite image of harbor with waterfront docks, vessels, and port-like shore structures, different from bridge by lacking a simple crossing form and from parking_lot by strong maritime context.
intersection: a satellite image of intersection with multiple roads crossing at a compact node, different from roundabout by lacking a circular center and from overpass by weaker layered elevation.
meadow: a satellite image of meadow with open grass-covered land and soft natural vegetation texture, different from forest by lacking dense canopy and from rectangular_farmland by lacking regular cultivated parcels.
overpass: a satellite image of overpass with elevated crossing and clear grade separation, different from bridge by stronger road-over-road pattern and from intersection by stronger elevated overlap.
parking_lot: a satellite image of parking_lot with broad paved ground and regular parked-vehicle rows, different from industrial_area by lacking dense factory compounds and from harbor by lacking water-adjacent docks.
railway: a satellite image of railway with long parallel tracks and linear rail transport pattern, different from railway_station by lacking concentrated station structures and from bridge by lacking a localized crossing shape.
river: a satellite image of river with continuous elongated water flow and visible banks, different from lake by more linear channel geometry and from wetland by clearer continuous channel structure.
sparse_residential: a satellite image of sparse_residential with widely separated houses and large open gaps, different from dense_residential by far lower roof density and from mobile_home_park by lacking uniform trailer-like rows.
stadium: a satellite image of stadium with a prominent sports venue and stronger enclosing structure, different from baseball_diamond by larger scale and from ground_track_field by stronger venue framing.
storage_tank: a satellite image of storage_tank with regular circular tank clusters and strong round industrial geometry, different from industrial_area by circular-container dominance and from church by lacking landmark-building structure.
